payload.claim: The spec's "Out of scope > Hand edits" section states: "DESIGN.md §5.5 and CONTEXT.md's REVIEW_INCOMPLETE entry say no finding set exists to rebut. That stays true until SA-0407 changes the route, so its pull request carries both edits." This is false at the stated base commit (cab685b547c8d100d4c6c0b17e58861d97af149e). Two already-landed commits ahead of a5c1f2e9 (82430dfd and 9e6b0ec7, both explicitly tagged "(SA-0407)") already rewrote DESIGN.md §5.5, its §3.3 legend, and CONTEXT.md's REVIEW_INCOMPLETE entry to state, in the present tense, that host-filed survivors already go to REBUT beside a lens with an error, and that the line names each such survivor and what the post-rebuttal probe left of it, the very edits this spec says SA-0407's own future pull request will carry. The "stays true until SA-0407 changes the route" framing has already been overtaken. This costs nothing in practice: SA-0406 already forbids editing DESIGN.md/CONTEXT.md, the conventions lens only judges hunks the diff touches (and SA-0406's diff never touches or cites those lines), and no gate cross-checks doc prose against code behavior, so no criterion is affected and no cell action changes. It names no acceptance criterion and is about the narrative text in "Out of scope," not about anything the cell must build or test, so it carries no blocker tag.
